title: רב מנשה בר זביד
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rav Menashe bar Zevid sat before Rav Huna, Yevamot 19b. He said: Rav said, Menaḥot 108b; Shevuot 45b. This is no proof that he was Rav's student, since he sat before Rav Huna. I am uncertain whether this is the son of the otherwise unspecified Rav Zevid who spoke in Abaye's name and before Amemar, Mar Zutra and Rav Ashi, since he sat before the earlier Rav Huna.
